en: The image features a man in traditional Korean attire, sitting in front of a decorative folding screen adorned with nature and bird motifs. He is wearing a gat, a traditional Korean hat, and formal hanbok robes, with a long necklace that may signify rank. The setting appears to be indoors, with traditional Korean architecture visible in the background. There is calligraphy on the folding screen and wall.
